home.tagline:
Brands with authority,
from the first sketch
to the published site.
paragraphs: Many brands lose strength because every piece is made by someone different and none of them look alike. Before I turned to design, I ran my family's business, so I know what it costs when a business looks like less than it is.

I work on each brand from the identity to its applications, and when the project calls for a website, I build that too. I know both sides well, and I make sure what gets published stays true to what was designed.
For five years I've been strategically building authority for brands in Brazil and Spain.

steps.title: Understand
steps.text: Before I sketch anything, I listen and research to define what the brand needs to communicate.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: I build the identity as a system, made to work in any format.

steps.title: Apply
steps.text: I carry it into every piece, from paper to screen, and everything speaks the same language.

testimonials.quote: We started without a clear concept, and they helped us define the brand's goals and direction. They put care into everything, from the strategy to the visuals and the website.

testimonials.quote: You made a dream come true. Now the brand conveys exactly what Wotë is, and it's ready for the international market.
testimonials.name: Luciana K.

testimonials.quote: It was a great process, from the name to the visual identity. It all turned out beautiful and conveys exactly what I had in mind.

home.focusText: I'm a Brazilian graphic and web designer, based in Valencia since 2023. For more than five years I've worked in branding, digital design and web development, bringing together strategy, aesthetics and code. I don't design to decorate: every piece has a reason.

jobs.text: Complete visual identities and the websites that support them, hand-coded in HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Print and digital pieces, creative direction for social media and end-to-end management of each project, from brief to delivery.
Landing pages and corporate websites focused on UX/UI and responsive design. Brand management for several clients at once and conversion-driven campaigns on Meta Ads and Google Ads.
Creative direction and production of corporate, product and event shoots. Professional editing and retouching in Lightroom and Photoshop.

intro.title: What I do with the data you send me
intro.text: This site has no sign-up, analytics or ads. The only personal data I collect is what you write in the contact form, and I only use it to reply to you.

items.text: Gustavo Tondin, freelance graphic designer based in Valencia (Spain). Contact: gus.tondin@gmail.com.
Your name, email address and the message you write. When checking the captcha, hCaptcha also processes technical browser data, such as your IP address and how you interact with the page.
To reply to your message and, if you ask, to prepare a quote. I don't send newsletters or use your data for advertising.
Your own request: by sending the form you ask me for a reply (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). The captcha relies on my legitimate interest in protecting the form from spam (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

Web3Forms, which receives the form and forwards it to my inbox; hCaptcha (Intuition Machines, Inc.), which checks that you are a person; and Google, which hosts my email. They may process data outside the European Economic Area, mainly in the United States; hCaptcha and Google take part in the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework. I don't share your data with anyone else.

I keep the message for as long as the conversation lasts and, if we work together, for the duration of the work and any legal periods that apply. Otherwise, I delete it within 12 months at the latest. Web3Forms keeps a copy for 30 days.

You can request access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction or portability of your data by writing to gus.tondin@gmail.com. If you think I haven't handled it properly, you can file a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD).

site.title: What the site loads
site.text: The site is hosted on GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc.), which logs visitors' IP addresses for security. Fonts are downloaded from Google Fonts and Fontshare, which also receive your IP address. I don't set any cookies of my own. hCaptcha only loads once you start filling in the form and may use technical cookies needed for the check.
